tasks.design: Add idempotent migration sql/20261108_MaTuSinhSequence.sql: dbo.MaTuSinhSequence(prefix NVARCHAR(80) PK,giaTri BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK>=0). No USE, DROP DATABASE, seed deletion or credentials. In MaTuSinhHelper replace numeric MAX/cache allocation for both generic and daily IDs with same-connection JDBC transaction SERIALIZABLE: SELECT giaTri with UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK by prefix; if absent initialize by MAX TRY_CONVERT existing entity suffix on that same connection; next=max+1; insert/update reserved value and commit before return. Rollback and close on any failure; if table absent throw clear IllegalStateException requesting migration, never silently fall back. Retry a SQL deadlock at most 3 times. Existing prefix/format/public signatures remain; gaps are acceptable and never reused. No int overflow: validate next<=Integer.MAX_VALUE. sinhMaTheSpaPass must use same reservation mechanism with PASS-phone- prefix and actual max suffix, replacing COUNT and silent error fallback. sinhMaPhanCong may keep temporary cache because actual DAO uses IDENTITY. DBConnection stays unchanged. Prefix/table/column are private internal constants, SQL values bound, not arbitrary user SQL.

tasks.goal: Reject invalid sales, protect stock expiry, resolve base unit when splitting packs, serialize/check returns and preserve stored invoice values.
tasks.design: HoaDonDAO: validate positive ct.soLuong and export base qty, nonnegative prices/line totals/discount/header, known employee before opening transaction. Sum stored ct totals, expected header=max(0,sum-discount); require agreement within 0.01. Allow at most 1 VND line rounding difference from qty*unitPrice for existing split allocation; no negative values. Stock UPDATE must require HSD>=CAST(GETDATE AS DATE) and positive guarded quantity; keep rowcount check/rollback. If xuatLo.QuyDoiDonVi missing, look up real base QD for that lot product with tyLeQuyDoi=1 within same transaction, ordered laDonViCoSo desc, maQD; bind its real ID, never NULL or fake. Validate QD and lot match product and base quantity equals quantity*ratio. Restore ct.thanhTien from ResultSet and preserve original header totals after loading child lists in getAllHoaDon/findById instead of recomputing DB values. Add ChiTietDoiTra.soLuongCoSoTra int property for returned base quantity INDEPENDENT of restock quantity, getters/setters. Add idempotent script sql/20261108_DoiTraCoSo.sql adding nullable soLuongCoSoTra INT CHECK>0 when nonnull. Conservatively backfill only from positive restock or unambiguous original sale unit ratio; unresolved legacy rows remain NULL, never invent quantity. In luuPhieuDoiTraTrongTransaction lock source HoaDon row UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK before checking returns, require paid source invoice. Validate every return qty>0, refund>=0; derive missing base qty only from positive restock or a single unambiguous original product conversion, otherwise reject actionable ambiguity. Under source invoice lock aggregate all prior returned base qty and current proposed base qty per product, compare to actual original ChiTietXuatLo base sold; reject over-return including two concurrent quays. Any prior unresolved NULL for that product blocks further returns pending reconciliation. If restocking, require soLo was actually sold by original invoice for same product and 0<restock<=returned base, and restock total for that lot cannot exceed sold amount. Damaged return uses restock=0 but still records positive returned base qty. Persist new base column with bound parameter, keep existing soLuongDoiTra display qty. Validate all before committing; rollback source lock, header, points, lots together. Do not implement Hotel/Spa changes in this task. Do not change public method signatures. Codex will propagate new returned-base field through GUI/DTO afterward.

For legacy unmarked request support only DV004 service lines (not hotel) as fallback; require positive count, no simultaneous theMoi. Require invoice linked customer phone matches card customer. UPDATE TheSpaPass + count with guard remaining>=count, valid status/date; insert one history row with soLuot=count. tasks.goal: Saving customer contact/profile must not overwrite loyalty points, even with stale client data or cashier role.
tasks.design: Add KhachHangDAO.updateProfile(KhachHang) which updates name/phone/email/address ONLY, preserving SQL diemTichLuy (include fallback legacy columns if existing DAO already supports). Generic BanHangBus.luuHoacCapNhatKhachHang overloads always use updateProfile for existing customer, ignore diemMoi; new profile starts at 0 points. Explicit capNhatThongTinKhachHang methods permit point edits ONLY when UserSession.isQuanLy; nonmanager profile saves use updateProfile and do not mutate cached points. KhachHangDAO.update (legacy method that writes points) must itself preserve points via updateProfile for nonmanagers, to prevent callers bypassing BUS. Update RAM only after SQL success; re-fetch persisted points or retain authoritative DB value, no stale write-back. Do not alter atomic increment/decrement used by POS. Preserve public signatures and manager manual adjustment capability.
